explanation: Very sparse feature that fires during the original phase at steps 3-5 (mostly step 4). It is driven by several cues adding together: the input is q (79% of mass), the sequence starts with x (or less often l), and the previous input is j (sometimes m), with m/j often appearing earlier too. The strongest activations (about 0.7-1.0 of max) are sequences like x ? ? j [q]. With only some of these cues (for example x..j followed by a token other than q, or q without the x/l start) it fires weakly or not at all. Many steps that meet every condition stay inactive (precision about 0.4), so the conjunction does not fully determine firing. It never fires in the copy phase, rarely fires at <DEL>, and never fires at t<3 or t>6.
